svg.title: Campus corpus generation for one place
svg.desc: How the aliases, concepts, and authored queries of one place become labeled rows: navigate, explain, and story rows per alias from fixed templates; recommend rows per uniquely owned concept; authored rows as written.
svg.text: CORPUS GENERATION -- one place expanded (rca-1802)
WHAT: 965 rows from the whole snapshot; each row is a query with an intent label, a destination label, a kind, and a place.
aliases
rca 1802|the 1802|cdp1802|cosmac|cosmac elf|rca processor|the 1802 demo|1802 assembly emulator|1802 io demo
concepts
microprocessor|8-bit|1970s hobby computing|assembly language|input and output|cmos|spacecraft computers
authored
navigate:show me the rca processor|navigate:where is the cosmac demo|navigate:i want to see an e ...
intent
template family
generated rows (first two)
label
navigate where is A / take me to A ...
where is rca 1802 / take me to rca 1802
explain what is A / tell me about A ...
what is rca 1802 / tell me about rca 1802
story tell me a story about A ...
tell me a story about rca 1802 / any anecdotes about rca 1802
recommend i am interested in C ...
i am interested in microprocessor / something about microprocessor
This place yields 136 rows: 9 aliases x (4 + 3 + 2 + 3) templates + 7 unique concepts x 3 + 7 authored.
WHY: a few hundred inspectable rows beat thousands of generated ones; a visitor can read the whole training set.
WHY: a concept owned by two places (computer history) would give one text two labels, so it makes no rows;
ambiguity is authored instead: 9 rows carry an expected top-2 set for the ambiguity panel of CD04. Status rows
(is A finished, does A work yet) are answered by each place's canned status sentence and maturity level.
HOW: u:campus_corpus walks places in snapshot order and templates in fixed order (no randomness); rows accumulate
as newline-joined strings and split once at the end, because string lists cannot be appended in place.
HOW: generic story rows (tell me that again, another story) and unsupported rows (weather, jokes) have destination none;
intents are navigate, explain, recommend, story, status, unsupported; destinations are the 9 places plus none.
Everything the model will see is lowercase by construction; tests/test_campus.mlpl asserts the counts and labels.
